'''Lowban Terlq''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] weapons merchant dealing only in [[Pistol/Legends|pistols]], [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blasters]], [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]], [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistols]] and the occasional [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]]. He owned a small wilderness outfitter shop near the edge of [[Gadrin]], named ''[[Life Vines]]''.
